metadata.description: Live-captured DELETE /api/mdm/profiles/{profileId} against UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-07-30. Real-wire finding: same as profiles_apple_delete.json / profiles_appleosx_delete.json -- response carries X-Api-Version: v1 even though the request sent Accept version=2, body empty (200, Content-Length 0). --accept-version 2 passed explicitly to route around the default --swagger-dir's false v1/v3 ambiguity (see profiles_appleosx_delete.json for detail); the route itself is unambiguous in the swagger source actually used by codegen.
